observations: Masonry (showcase fixture): DataLayouts story passes width={320} to Masonry (width is a required caller-measured prop), so at 768 and 1440 the grid stays 2x~160px columns in the left 320px of a 662/1158px area. Component-by-contract, but the fixture never demonstrates responsive width. screens/wide/Masonry-renderer.png, screens/tablet/Masonry-renderer.png

BottomNavigation at 1440: bar presentation has maxWidth null, so 2 items sit 720px apart across the full width. Contract says web adaptive = fixed-compact-viewport (host should swap to Sidebar on wide); floating presentation caps at 384. screens/wide/BottomNavigation.png

Width policy is inconsistent at 1440: Field caps (~420px) while SearchField, Select, Combobox, PasswordField, TextArea, NumberField (value centred ~570px from each stepper), Slider, AuthProviderButton, BottomCTA and DateRangePicker (day cells ~165px apart) fill the 1158px renderer; Calendar caps at ~500px. Not broken, but hosts must constrain widths themselves. screens/wide/*.png

Landscape 844x390: all overlays inside viewport except DatePicker (WR-0930-3); Popover/Select/Combobox/Menu flip above the trigger; Sheet is 640px centred; SidePanel 400px docked right and tap-outside dismisses. BottomNavigation fixed bar takes ~60px of the 390 height (expected).

Tap outside: AlertDialog stays (expected for destructive confirm), Tour stays (explicit 그만 보기), SidePanel at 390 covers the full viewport so there is no outside area; close controls closed all of them.

Chip small size is 36px tall with no hit slop (hit 44x36 / 63x36); Card 자세히 hit 64x42; Anchor tabs 38px tall; standalone text links (Link, Breadcrumb, QRCode 공유 페이지 열기) 17-20px tall. WCAG 2.5.8 (24px) mostly satisfied by spacing; below the 44px guideline.
